objective: Represent a locus as strand-aware junction edges and exact molecule-class path fragments without reconstructing full transcripts.

evidence_semantics.edge: a splice junction observed in at least one archived representative placement
evidence_semantics.path_fragment: the sorted set of selected locus junctions co-supported by one archive UMI class on one strand
evidence_semantics.deduplication: one count per archive UMI class for an edge or exact path fragment
evidence_semantics.scope: cell, frozen cell group, or bulk using the existing strict archive-barcode scope
evidence_semantics.strand: forward and reverse evidence are separate graphs
evidence_semantics.multimappers: count archived anchor-placement junction evidence without resolving alternatives
forbidden_interpretation: a path fragment is a complete transcript
absence of an edge proves biological absence
cells or molecules are biological replicates
archive representative reduction preserves every read-level co-occurrence

query_gate.overflow: hard error; never truncate paths silently
output: exact edge UMI and cell counts
exact path-fragment UMI and cell counts
per-group counts when a frozen group map is supplied
planning counts and explicit lower-bound semantics

replicate_layer.phase: next after the exact per-shard primitive
replicate_layer.unit: sample or donor from an explicit design table
replicate_layer.required_behavior: retain one exact count row per biological replicate before any beta-binomial or Dirichlet-multinomial contrast
replicate_layer.not_in_v1_query_gate: no population p-value or differential-splicing claim

acceptance: a synthetic molecule spanning two junctions produces one two-edge path fragment
repeated representatives and archive chunks cannot double-count a UMI class
edge counts equal the union of path fragments containing that edge
cell/group/bulk scope totals agree under the same selected cells
malformed loci, zero thresholds, overflow, and invalid scope fail closed
all pre-existing query golden tests remain unchanged
